description: This file defines the React component NoteView, which is part of a note-taking or documentation application. It manages the rendering and interaction logic for a single note, including title editing, content display (plain, component-based, or super editor), handling protected notes, and managing associated components and stack extensions. It also handles synchronization status, error states, and user interactions such as resizing and deletion.

classes.name: NoteView
classes.description: React component managing the display and interaction of a single note within the application, including editing, component stacking, protected overlays, and status indicators.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initializes event listeners, observers, and loads the editor and stack components after mounting.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates when component's props or state change, e.g., reloading editor on showProtectedWarning change.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Performs cleanup of observers and component instances.

methods.name: reloadEditorComponent
methods.description: Loads or reloads the editor component based on current note status and protection overlays.

methods.name: reloadStackComponents
methods.description: Loads available stack extension components related to the note.

methods.name: toggleStackComponent
methods.description: Enables or disables a stack component for the current note and triggers a sync.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Handles note deletion, either soft (trash) or permanent, with confirmation dialogs.

methods.name: onPanelResizeFinish
methods.description: Handles finalization of panel resize actions, saving preferences.

methods.name: reloadPreferences
methods.description: Reloads user preferences related to font, layout, and features.

methods.name: reloadSpellcheck
methods.description: Reloads the spellcheck setting for the note.

methods.name: showSavingStatus
methods.description: Sets UI status to indicate saving is in progress.

methods.name: showAllChangesSavedStatus
methods.description: Sets UI status to indicate all changes are saved.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Schedules and updates the note's status indicator with debounce.

methods.name: onTitleChange
methods.description: Handles title editing, updates state, and saves changes.

methods.name: setShowProtectedOverlay
methods.description: Shows or hides the protected overlay warning.

methods.name: authorizeAndDismissProtectedWarning
methods.description: Handles user authorization for protected notes, dismisses overlay.

methods.name: streamItems
methods.description: Sets up observers for real-time updates of linked components.
